caption: The drawing depicts a metal steelyard balance scale suspended on a light beige or off-white background. The scale consists of a long, horizontal, dark metallic bar with a round disc at its right end and a pointed, flat section on the left. Multiple hooks, all of a dark, possibly iron color, hang from the left side: one hook at the top for suspension, two hooks below for weighing objects. In the center, suspended from a ring, hangs a dark, teardrop-shaped weight. The metal objects are rendered with detail, showing subtle highlights and rust-colored patches, indicating aged metal. The composition is centered, and the objects are arranged horizontally, occupying most of the space in the middle of the drawing. The artist's signature, "Haim Grossin," appears in small text below the objects.
title: Scales
